Customers are encouraged to setup a few tills on the preview channels to test drive new updates before being promoted to stable.

The maintenance exclusion window for the update. The exclusion maintenance period takes precedence over any scheduled maintenance window. Maximum of 30 days allowed. The exlusion window is applied only for stable channel and only for major and minor updates(semantic versioning).
The start date and time of the maintenance exclusion. Specify in the UTC time zone.
The number of days from the start date for the maintenance exclusion to take precedence. Maximum 30 days.

The maintenance window for the update. During this window the update will download and install automatically. To start update the app must be open else it will try to update on the next maintenance window. The maintenance window is applied to preview and stable channels for major, minor and patch updates(see semantic versioning)
Days of the week when maintenance updates can occur.
The start time of the maintenance window, e.g. 18:00:00. Specify in the UTC time zone.
The end time of the maintenance window, e.g. 23:59:00. Specify in the UTC time zone.

#/properties/pos/properties/quickSearch/: Extra Kibana Query Language (KQL) clause that is always AND-ed with every quick search. Use it to pre-narrow the catalog (assortment, brand, tags, additional properties, and similar) so typical searches run against a smaller set of items. This is not a default search term and is not shown or editable in the POS. Cashiers still type a query as usual. Leave unset, null, or empty for no extra filtering. Platform constraints still apply (sellable STOCK/SERVICE items, current sales prices, active identifiers, and item status). Invalid KQL makes quick search fail for all users — test the expression in the Complete Item query playground before rollout. KQL syntax: https://www.elastic.co/docs/explore-analyze/query-filter/languages/kql Complete Item fields and nested additional-property syntax: https://developer.hiiretail.com/docs/product-price-and-promotion/concepts/capabilities/querying-for-data/#how-it-works
